module: Reads a camera path that follows the rally route. From the points of a 'snaproad' (pointsForCameraPath), it builds a camera path (an adapted copy of core_paths.loadPath) and plays it with core_paths.playPath. Fixed parameters in play: 40 m before, 20 m after, 2 m height, FOV 70, playback speed 80 km/h. The module returns a constructor: require(...)(snaproad).
notes: The time of each marker = cumulative distance / playback speed (m/s): the camera moves at constant speed, regardless of point spacing.
In loadPath, 'movingStart or true' and 'movingEnd or true' are always true (a false value would be ignored).
The local function loadPath returns a path table without registering it (addPath is commented out).

C.desc: Camera path player returned by the module constructor.

init.desc: Stores the snaproad used to produce the path points.

play.desc: Requests the points from the snaproad (40 m before, 20 m after), builds the camera path and starts it with core_paths.playPath. Does nothing if no points are returned.
